answer: Admission auction stops bulk fakes: 50 slots per epoch. First, each applicant posts a bond of twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, and bids openly. Second, one beacon clearing price closes any cheap ledge for hidden bids. Third, winners work from one knoll on a tundra plain, where duplicates show. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 units, 2000 units, against a 300-unit reward. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
